keyFindings.description: Security[untrusted-input]/Security[prompt]: decodeServerStarted returns server.started's `commit` with no shape check; outbox.go:1356 concatenates it into the implement App's GitHub compare path (`/compare/<merge>...<build>`) and check.go:141 embeds it verbatim in the implementer's check task and the record's last_wake_detail. The listener's publish route takes `source: dispatch` and a free payload from any caller (packages/envoy/cmd/listener/api.go:329-335,613), so an agent-published envelope on notifications.dispatch.server.started with commit `main#<text>` is compared as `...main` (url.Parse cuts at #), answers ahead, and the whole string wakes the look and reaches the prompt; each distinct string is a new wake, each queues a check_compare row per open check. Fix: refuse a build that is not ^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$ at compareBuilds (covering the daemon's revision, server.started and Dispatch's /healthz build alike) or at decode, and build the compare path with url.PathEscape. ASVS v5.0.0-1.2.5.

The 'runs again' predicate `RoleFor(issue.Phase) != ""` (check.go:234 endLookPending, :270 closeCheck, :365 wake, :484 checkBound) is false for `admitted` and `held`, and `admitted` is where admit.readmit (admit.go:642) puts a root reopened inside its linger, with its open check untouched. A wake or the bound in that window starts a look: the check start row resumes the implementer and relaunches the Sandbox (outbox.go:740-743 fences the row on the check alone) for a tree that may be waiting for a slot, against the spec's 'starts no look and suspends nobody'. engine.go:575-583 claimFailed ends an open look before the done/lingering gate, so an implementer dying in a live phase with a stale open look is neither held nor reported (worker-died/held skipped). Fix: use inWorkflow(issue) (linger.go:158) at the four sites, gate claimFailed's look-end on !inWorkflow, and have checkLookHolds refuse a start whose issue is in the workflow (or close the open check at readmit as ReenterChild does, engine.go:379-392); a workflow test for a reopened root in admitted receiving a wake.

leave derives `merged` from the status and the pull request alone and ends with openCheck (linger.go:110), which upserts on issue (record/store.go PutProductionCheck): a done child a human parks (backlog) and sets done again gets a fresh check over the recorded one (outcome and looks overwritten, the implementer woken again). Skip openCheck when a check for the same repo/pr_number/merge_sha already exists. Behavioural, so fixed in this round beside the two above.

The plugin's check-report test adds `record.check !== undefined` to the daemon's rule (handoff.go:90: implementer && phase done): a done issue whose check closed falls to the phase path, runs runtime.handoffCommit('done', role) and posts a commit the daemon answers CHECK_NOT_OPEN anyway. Match the daemon's condition so the agent sees the one refusal.
